decision_basis: Completed saved DEV evaluation; final native replay and stage delivery remain required before final closeout.
interpretation: The 128-step numerical prerequisite is satisfied, allowing actual response evaluation. The fixed noise-completion candidate improves descriptive PSD distance relative to its fixed-noise control, but does not pass absolute PSD, full SOURCE response, same-treated REAL voltage, or required density criteria. Source IDs and charge ranks alone do not establish preserved source-conditional PSD. All five original-view paired BA intervals for both SOURCE and REAL include zero, so these comparisons do not establish a uniform full-response advantage of noise completion. The REAL voltage discrepancy remains unexplained by these saved aggregates; baseline restoration, amplitude structure and quantization are hypotheses, not established causes.
next_direction: Treat R49 as a closed fixed recipe, retaining its useful numerical and REAL-identity findings. A distinct next protocol should first isolate the same-treated REAL full-voltage discrepancy from baseline, amplitude and quantization using saved outputs, then specify a response change that preserves source-conditional PSD and controls noise. Keep all original populations and A-F thresholds. Do not use more integration steps, a selected control winner, dropped density bins or marginal reweighting to claim this recipe accepted.
next_action: Finish all 8000 independent main replay rows, rendered figure checks, native sealing, private Git publication and D normal-copy delivery. Preserve the resulting negative evidence. Any next scientific stage is a separately registered substantive protocol under the existing no-compute-budget authorization; no A-C-qualified model exists for D/E validation.
